lessons.title: मला वाटतं की … (malā vāṭtaṁ kī …) — what I think
lessons.gloss: I think that … — an opinion, on the verb of feeling

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say "I feel fine", with the verb that puts you in the dative. (malā baraṁ vāṭtaṁ.) Then "Meera says that Marathi is easy". (mīrā mhaṇte kī marāṭhī sopaṁ āhe.)

segments.source: [PAUSE 1s]

segments.text: Put the two together and you have an opinion.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: मला वाटतं की …

segments.text: मला वाटतं की उद्या पाऊस पडेल. malā vāṭtaṁ kī udyā pāūs paḍel. — "I think it will rain tomorrow."

Word for word: "to me it seems that tomorrow rain will fall". The thinker stands in the dative, as with आवडणे; की opens the opinion, and the opinion is a whole sentence. To ask: तुम्हाला काय वाटतं? (tumhālā kāy vāṭtaṁ?), "What do you think?" In the past: मला वाटलं की … (malā vāṭlaṁ kī …), "I thought that …". "I don't think so": मला असं वाटत नाही (malā asaṁ vāṭat nāhī), with असं (asaṁ, "so, like this").

blocks.title: You'll want to know: माझ्या मते, 'in my opinion'

segments.text: माझ्या मते हा चित्रपट चांगला आहे. mājhyā mate hā citrapaṭ cāṅglā āhe. — "In my opinion this film is good."
मते is मत, "an opinion", the word inside मत देणे, "to vote", with an ending; माझ्या is माझा bent to fit it. It sits at the front of the sentence, and it sounds firmer than मला वाटतं.

lessons.title: म्हणून (mhaṇūn) — so, and because of that
lessons.gloss: so, that is why — the result after its reason, and त्यामुळे

segments.source: [PAUSE 2s]

segments.text: Say "because", the word that answers का. (kāraṇ.) Then "it was raining". (pāūs paḍat hotā.)
पाऊस पडत होता, म्हणून मी घरी राहिलो. pāūs paḍat hotā, mhaṇūn mī gharī rāhilo. — "It was raining, so I stayed at home."
कारण gives the reason after the event; म्हणून (mhaṇūn) gives the result after the reason. Same two facts, opposite order: मी घरी राहिलो, कारण पाऊस पडत होता (mī gharī rāhilo, kāraṇ pāūs paḍat hotā).
म्हणून (mhaṇūn) is built like करून: the -ऊन form of म्हणणे, "to say".

blocks.title: You'll want to know: त्यामुळे, 'because of that'

segments.text: काल खूप पाऊस होता, त्यामुळे आम्ही बाहेर गेलो नाही. kāl khūp pāūs hotā, tyāmuḷe āmhī bāher gelo nāhī. — "Yesterday there was a lot of rain, so we didn't go out."
त्यामुळे (tyāmuḷe) is त्या, "that", and -मुळे, "because of". It leans on the cause: "because of that". Where म्हणून (mhaṇūn) often marks a choice someone made, त्यामुळे marks what came of something.
